    { q: 'What is 0.6 × 0.4?', opts: ['0.24', '2.4', '0.024', '24'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'Write 4/5 as a decimal.', opts: ['0.8', '0.4', '0.75', '0.85'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'A loaf of bread costs R18.99. How much change from R50?', opts: ['R31.01', 'R32.01', 'R31.11', 'R30.01'], ans: 0 },
    { q: 'What is 2.5 × 4?', opts: ['10', '8', '12', '9'], ans: 0 },
